name: jira-ticket-creator
description: Create Jira tickets in bulk using AI-powered field extraction via GitHub Copilot

jiraTicketCreator.baseUrl.description: Jira base URL (e.g., https://jira.mycompany.com or https://myorg.atlassian.net)

jiraTicketCreator.defaultIssueType.description: Default issue type for new tickets

jiraTicketCreator.issueTypes.description: Available issue types shown in the UI

jiraTicketCreator.customFields.description: Custom Jira fields to include (e.g., {"customfield_10001": "default value"})

jiraTicketCreator.promptTemplate.description: Custom AI prompt template (leave empty for default). Use {issueTypes} and {description} as placeholders.

jiraTicketCreator.defaultLabels.description: Labels automatically applied to every created ticket

jiraTicketCreator.defaultComponents.description: Components automatically applied to every created ticket

jiraTicketCreator.sendPriority.description: Send priority field when creating tickets (disable if your Jira screen doesn't support it)
